opening.argument: The video presents Bitcoin and ether mining-pool participation as a route to passive income, pairing claims of easy cryptocurrency earnings and free equipment with reported returns exceeding nine bitcoins and 12,255,000 dollars over one year and three months. The speaker attributes more than nine bitcoins to a purchased mining pool, stating, "I've bought a pool worth 3000 half thousand dollars in 2014 in November he gave me more than nine bitcoins." It further promotes automatic equipment purchases as increasing profits and links the opportunity to registration. The title itself frames the subject as "Passive Income" through Bitcoin investment, while the on-screen material directs viewers to register and says auto-reinvestment increases income.
